name: Directive (EU) 2024/2853 on liability for defective products
description: Replaces the 1985 Product Liability Directive (85/374/EEC). Extends strict (no-fault) liability to software, AI systems, and digital manufacturing files as 'products', eases the claimant's burden of proof (including for AI's technical complexity), and covers damage from defective updates.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by European Union (europa.eu) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within European Union (europa.eu).
